scope: Complete 128-page visual review with bounded chilled-water/heating-water/AHU/VAV/exhaust control evidence and explicit non-inference limits.
reading_notes: M-701/M-702 are deep plant control/sequence sources.

All retained rows and assertions are independently rechecked against MuPDF and Poppler.
